meta.description: MS Square is a Sudanese company specialized in contracting, construction, and engineering consulting, delivering integrated engineering and construction solutions for the public and private sectors.

hero.title: Engineering Consulting & Solutions
hero.text: MS Square is a Sudanese company specialized in contracting, construction, and engineering consulting. We deliver your projects from full construction to finishing, rehabilitation, and maintenance, with the highest standards of quality and safety.

about.heading: Who We Are, Our Mission & Vision
about.aboutText: MS Square is a Sudanese company specialized in contracting, construction, and engineering consulting, providing integrated engineering and construction solutions for the public and private sectors — from consulting and engineering design, to full construction, finishing, rehabilitation, maintenance, and infrastructure support, in addition to supplying construction materials.
about.missionText: To deliver reliable construction and engineering solutions that meet the highest standards of quality, safety, and efficiency, while building long-term client relationships through professionalism, transparency, and consistent performance.
about.visionText: To become one of the leading contracting and engineering companies in Sudan and the region, by delivering sustainable projects, maintaining the highest execution standards, and earning client trust through excellence at every project stage.

services.heading: Comprehensive Contracting Solutions Under One Roof
items: Construction of residential, commercial, and industrial buildings
Turnkey projects, from planning to final handover
Custom general contracting solutions tailored to client needs

items.title: Professional Engineering Team
items.text: Field experience combined with engineering expertise to deliver work that meets technical standards.

items.title: Precision in Every Detail
items.text: Every stage is planned, monitored, and executed for durable, reliable results.

items.title: Efficient Project Delivery
items.text: Organized planning and disciplined site management to deliver on the agreed timeline.

items.title: Comprehensive Construction Solutions
items.text: From structure and construction to finishing, maintenance, and supply — one trusted partner.

items.title: Commitment to Quality & Safety
items.text: Strict quality control procedures and a priority on safe work practices.

items.title: Client-Focused Approach
items.text: A clear understanding of client goals, practical solutions, and transparent communication.

items.title: Sofia Water Factory Buildings
items.text: Construction of the factory's main buildings, including reinforced concrete structural works, masonry, roofing systems, and external site works. Fully executed according to approved engineering specifications.

items.title: Sally Soap Factory — Buildings & Finishing
items.text: Construction of the factory buildings with complete interior and exterior architectural finishing, delivering a fully functional industrial facility to high quality standards.

items.title: Albarjoub Company — Workshop & Sales Offices
items.text: Construction of workshop facilities and sales offices, including civil works, architectural finishing, utility installations, and supporting infrastructure.
